name: Blixo
long_description:
Blixo is an all-in-one replacement for things like subscription management, invoicing, collections, and cash application software.

Blixo improves conversion rates, increases average order size, drives subscriber loyalty, collects unpaid bills, speeds up cashflow, and is the single source of truth for reconciled real time revenue data.
one_liner: Accounts receivable automation to help companies get paid faster

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Launched several multimillion dollar businesses—one made hundreds of millions in revenue, one made millions in the first year alone and grew to tens of millions in revenue after two years, and another was acquired in less than one year. Was also part of the founding team of the most popular legal website on the Internet and created one of the most played online games in the world while still in high school, garnering over 40 million visitors per month.
